name: OmniMatBench v2 — Vanilla
protocol: OmniMatBench v2 fixed 3,171-item full suite, vanilla zero-shot, Table 3 Avg score. Formula grounding, retrieval, code assistance, subsets, and component-only metrics are excluded.

explanation.en: Overall is the equal-weight mean of key-point QA macro-F1 and normalized exact-slot calculation accuracy over 3,171 items.
explanation.zh: Overall 是 3,171 道题上的 key-point QA macro-F1 与标准化 calculation exact-slot accuracy 的等权平均。

summary.en: OmniMatBench evaluates multimodal materials knowledge, reasoning, and schema-constrained calculation across a fixed full suite.
summary.zh: OmniMatBench 在固定 full suite 上评估多模态材料知识、推理和受 schema 约束的计算能力。

task_format.en: The model answers open materials questions and structured formula-heavy calculations using text with optional images or CSV inputs.
task_format.zh: 模型使用文本及可选图像或 CSV 输入，回答开放材料问题和带固定格式的公式计算题。
